headline: Southern New Hampshire outscore every other programme in the division
dek: Midwestern State are next on goals and have not lost all season, and neither have Cal State LA, Lincoln or Emory & Henry. Every one of them, Southern New Hampshire included, still has a match to play.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
